reply_text: @Sofia, it was **Pellow** (Pellow Home Living, formerly Covey & Lark Retail), not Pellucid. Your February 17 thread in #coastal-team settles it: you said the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments under "PHL" are Pellow, and Kwame confirmed that your retail account is the one showing the lamp delivery at door 6, not the container pickup. Pellucid Harbor Logistics is the Gulf Coast terminal account, which is where the "PHL" acronym collision came from.
